services.name: Massage
services.summary: An unhurried, full-body or focused session shaped around how you feel on the day.
services.description: A private massage session, paced to you. Your practitioner begins with a short conversation about what you would like from the time, then works with pressure and tempo you are comfortable with, whether that is a full-body session or closer attention to a few areas.
includes: A brief conversation before the session to agree focus and pressure
Hands-on massage for the full booked duration
Time to settle before and after, so the session never feels rushed
designedFor: Anyone who wants dedicated time to rest and unwind
People who train regularly and want recovery built into their week
Those who spend long days seated, travelling, or on their feet
whatToExpect: You choose the duration: 60, 90, or 120 minutes
Your practitioner checks in on pressure and comfort throughout
You remain appropriately draped at all times
You may ask to adjust, pause, or end the session at any point
precautions: Massage is not medical treatment and is not a substitute for care from a licensed healthcare provider.
If you are pregnant, recovering from surgery or injury, or managing a medical condition, please speak with your healthcare provider before booking.
Tell us in advance about allergies, skin sensitivities, or areas you would like avoided.
Please reschedule if you are unwell or have a fever.

services.name: Myofascial Release
services.summary: Slow, sustained hands-on work for areas that feel tight or restricted.
services.description: A slower style of hands-on work that uses sustained, gentle pressure rather than flowing strokes. Sessions concentrate on a small number of areas and move at a deliberate pace.
includes: A conversation about the areas you would like to focus on
Simple suggestions for movement between sessions
designedFor: People who prefer slow, focused work over a full-body session
Those who notice the same areas feeling tight week after week
whatToExpect: Little or no oil is used, so wear or bring comfortable clothing
Pressure is held for longer than in a typical massage
Your practitioner works within your comfort at all times
precautions: This session is not medical treatment and does not diagnose or treat any condition.
Please speak with your healthcare provider first if you have a medical condition, recent injury, or recent surgery.
Let us know about any areas that are painful or sensitive.

services.name: Stretch & Mobility
services.summary: Practitioner-guided stretching and movement, at a pace that suits you.
services.description: A guided session of assisted stretching and gentle movement. Your practitioner leads you through each position, working within a comfortable range and adjusting as you go.
includes: A short movement check-in to decide where to spend the time
A few movements to continue on your own
designedFor: People who want to move more comfortably day to day
Those who train and want mobility work alongside it
Anyone who finds it hard to make time to stretch
whatToExpect: You stay fully clothed, so wear something you can move in
Stretches are held within a comfortable range, never forced
precautions: This session is not medical treatment or physical therapy.
Please speak with your healthcare provider first if you have a joint condition, recent injury, or recent surgery.
Tell your practitioner straight away if any position is uncomfortable.

services.name: Muscle Activation
services.summary: Targeted, low-intensity work to prepare the body for movement.
services.description: A focused session of light, targeted exercises and hands-on cues intended to help you feel prepared for training or daily activity.
includes: A short routine to repeat before activity
designedFor: People preparing for training, sport, or an active day
Those returning to regular movement after time away
whatToExpect: You stay fully clothed, so wear something you can move in
Work is light and controlled rather than strenuous
precautions: This session is not medical treatment or physical therapy.
Please speak with your healthcare provider first if you have an injury or medical condition.
Stop and tell your practitioner if anything feels painful.

services.name: Massage + Muscle Activation
services.summary: Hands-on massage paired with guided activation in a single session.
services.description: A combined session that begins with massage and finishes with a short sequence of guided activation work, so you leave feeling both rested and ready to move.
includes: A conversation to agree how the time is divided
designedFor: People who want recovery and preparation in one appointment
Those with limited time who train regularly
whatToExpect: The session moves from the table to light movement
Bring or wear clothing you can move in for the second part
precautions: This session is not medical treatment and is not a substitute for care from a licensed healthcare provider.
Please speak with your healthcare provider first if you are pregnant, injured, or managing a medical condition.
Tell us in advance about allergies, sensitivities, or areas to avoid.
